summary: This clinical trial studies how a drug called empagliflozin affects sugar production in the liver and chemical levels called ketones in adults with type 2 diabetes. The study plans to enroll 30 participants who are between 30 and 75 years old. The sponsor for this research is The University of Texas Health Science Center at San Antonio. Currently, the trial is in Phase 1 and is actively recruiting participants.

facts.sponsor: The University of Texas Health Science Center at San Antonio
